In connection with the internal corporate reorganization of TTM Technologies, Inc. (the “Company”) disclosed below in Item 7.01, the Company determined on November 11, 2026 to transition Cathie Gridley’s position from Executive Vice President and President of the Company’s Aerospace & Defense sector to Special Advisor to the CEO. Ms. Gridley has been asked to remain with the Company in that role through June 30, 2027, and she has been presented with an agreement with regard to that Special Advisor role. Ms. Gridley’s role would be to assist with the transition to the Company’s new organizational model. Section 7 - Regulation FD Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure. On November 16, 2026, the Company issued a press release (the “Press Release”) to announce that it will reorganize its internal corporate configuration to combine the Company’s Commercial and Aerospace & Defense sectors into a single, unified business group, led by Doug Soder as Group President, effective immediately. A copy of the Press Release is furnished with this Current Report on Form 8-K (this “Report”) as Exhibit 99.1 and is incorporated by reference into this Item 7.01. The information furnished in this Item 7.01, including Exhibit 99.1, shall not be deemed to be “filed” for the purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “Exchange Act”), or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that section, and shall not be incorporated by reference into any registration statement or other document filed under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act, except as shall be expressly set forth by specific reference in such filing.
